retired.note: Replaced wholesale by the user-pinned modern minimalist world. Quality-bar rasters in .impeccable/mocks/quality/ are retired references kept for history only.

display.purpose: Opening headline, one span per line, balanced wrap. Weight 800.

title-risk.purpose: Risk statements, two columns on desktop.

lede.purpose: One-line explanation under the headline and the closing line; muted, max 52ch.

body.purpose: Notes and descriptions; section notes max 46ch.

label.purpose: Sub-group headings and fact labels; sentence case, no tracking.

code.purpose: Literal slash commands only. JetBrains Mono 500.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The only easing; used by the headline wipe and lede rise.

motion.name: headline-wipe
motion.value: wipe .9s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) backwards; line 2 delay .1s; clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) + translateY(.18em) -> inset(0 0 -.2em 0)
motion.purpose: One-time reveal of each opening headline line. Behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

motion.name: lede-rise
motion.value: rise .9s .25s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) backwards; opacity .001 + translateY(10px) -> rest
motion.purpose: Lede follows the headline. Behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

layout.section: block padding clamp(64px, 9vw, 96px); >=860px grid 4fr / 8fr, column-gap 48px; --full variant single column
layout.facts: stacked 28px gap; >=860px three equal columns, 40px gap

components.css: .ds-sample { background: var(--panel, #f0f1f3); color: var(--ink, #0f1115); border-radius: 20px; padding: clamp(22px, 4vw, 44px); display: grid; gap: 32px; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-sample p, .ds-sample h3 { margin: 0; } .ds-sample__head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-sample__title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-sample__meta { color: var(--muted, #5b616b); font-size: .9375rem; } .ds-pill { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--muted, #5b616b); color: var(--muted, #5b616b); font-size: .8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .02em; } .ds-sub { font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-list li { padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e4e8); } .ds-list li:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e2e4e8); } .ds-task { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 2px 16px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-task__what { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-task__meta { grid-column: 1; color: var(--muted, #5b616b); font-size: .9375rem; } .ds-task__status { grid-row: 1; grid-column: 2; font-size: .9375rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-task__status--late { color: var(--accent, #d2361a); } .ds-task__status--done { color: var(--muted, #5b616b); font-weight: 500; }

components.css: .ds-display { margin: 0; font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(3rem, 11.5vw, 8.75rem); font-weight: 800; line-height: .94; letter-spacing: -.04em; color: var(--ink, #0f1115); text-wrap: balance; } .ds-display span { display: block; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .ds-display span { animation: ds-wipe .9s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) backwards; } .ds-display span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .1s; } } @keyframes ds-wipe { from { clip-path: inset(0 0 100% 0); transform: translateY(.18em); } to { clip-path: inset(0 0 -.2em 0); transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A short, plain statement set in one confident grotesk, where size and space do all the work. The page reads like a notice someone wrote carefully: one very large sentence, a few facts, the evidence, the risks stated flatly. Hierarchy comes from scale jumps and heavy weights (800 display against 400 body), not from ornament, colour fields or containers.

The ground is a cool white in light mode and a near-black in dark mode, following prefers-color-scheme. Ink and one neutral gray carry all text. A single vermilion is the only colour on the page, and it is spent on objection and risk: the "Keberatan?" fact, the late task status, and the objection sentence. Density is low; sections are separated by generous vertical space, and the only filled surface is the soft gray panel that holds the sample summary.

This world rejects the bot-landing default of phone mockup, feature cards and green chat bubbles. The split-flap departure-board world that preceded it is retired.
keyCharacteristics: One grotesk family for everything; mono only for typed commands.
Display type at up to 8.75rem, weight 800, tight negative tracking.
Ink, one gray, one vermilion. Nothing else carries colour.
Whitespace separates groups; one soft gray panel; hairline rules only between list rows.
Light and dark token sets with identical roles.
One motion moment: the headline wipes in once on load.

rules.name: The One Hot Colour Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only where the reader's objection or a risk is at stake. If an element is not about refusing, lateness or risk, it is ink or gray.

rules.name: The Paired Scheme Rule
rules.body: Every colour role exists in both schemes; dark values are swapped on :root under prefers-color-scheme: dark (skipped when data-theme='light'). Never introduce a light-only colour.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Schibsted Grotesk sets every non-command word. Do not add a second display or serif face.

rules.name: The Typed-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono marks literal text the reader types into the group (/ringkas, /nonaktifkan). It is not a decorative label style.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow, no blur, no layered cards. If something needs separating, use space first, a hairline second, the panel tone only for the sample.

dos: Do let size and weight carry hierarchy: display 800 against body 400.
Do keep vermilion for objection, lateness and risk only.
Do separate groups with section spacing (clamp(64px, 9vw, 96px)) before reaching for a line or a surface.
Do set every typed command in JetBrains Mono 500.
Do define every new colour role in both light and dark token sets.
Do keep the headline wipe as the only entrance motion, and honour reduced motion.
donts: Don't use shadows, gradients or a second accent colour.
Don't wrap content in cards; the gray panel is reserved for sample output.
Don't use mono as a decorative label style or uppercase-tracked eyebrows above headings.
Don't reintroduce split-flap cells, Antonio, the amber/red board palette, or the retired quality-bar rasters as references.
Don't use phone mockups, chat bubbles or rows of icon cards.
